A Holiday Romance from the Pen of Miss Alice Rainbird, Aged 7
sourceTitle:
The Magic Fishbone
A Holiday Romance from the Pen of Miss Alice Rainbird, Aged 7
author: Charles Dickens
description: "The Magic Fishbone" by Charles Dickens is a children's tale presented as a whimsical story written during the late 19th century.
longDescription: This delightful narrative, which is part of a collection titled "Holiday Romance," encapsulates the adventures and challenges faced by a royal family, particularly focusing on the clever Princess Alicia.

authorInfo.bio: Charles Dickens was an English novelist and journalist whose memorable characters brought Victorian society to life. His stories combine humour, sympathy and criticism of poverty and injustice. His works include Oliver Twist, David Copperfield, Bleak House and Great Expectations.
authorInfo.edition: All five staves of the novella. Cover reproduced from the Project Gutenberg source EPUB.
